selected_evidence.requirement: Kernel boots with audit=1 and retains it across reboots
selected_evidence.summary: Both boot entries were configured with audit=1 before restart; after restart, the live kernel command line and both persistent entries contain audit=1.
Captured the healthy baseline and original boot ID, acknowledged the scheduled native reboot, proved a changed boot ID, and confirmed post-restart system and audit health.
